intent: Hypothesis to test: the Q3 contraction will recover within 12 weeks if we ship both fixes in parallel.

user_turns.text: Hypothesis: parallel recovery lands the index ≥ 100 by week 12.
Evidence FOR: peer comparable hit the same target in 8 weeks parallel.
Evidence AGAINST: peer team was 3× the size. Capacity asymmetry.
Scenario A: clean parallel. Index 102 by week 12.
Scenario B: coordination overhead drags reactivation to week 10. Index 92 by week 12.
Scenario C: a new regression lands during recovery. Index recovers but to 88, not 100.
Falsification test: weekly index in week 6 < 90 means scenario B or C is realising.

comparables.name: Peer parallel recovery — 8 weeks
comparables.diagnosis_summary: Index recovered to 102 in 8 weeks; team 3× our size.

output.triangulation_note: Peer comparable supports parallel; team-size asymmetry weakens the read.

tensions.description: Hypothesis assumes peer parallel works at our team size; capacity asymmetry says it might not.
evidence: Hypothesis predicts same 8-12wk recovery as peer.

claims.text: Hypothesis holds — index 102 by week 12 under clean parallel.
claims.confidence_rationale: Peer supports the trajectory but team-size asymmetry tempers.

claims.text: Hypothesis falsified — coordination drag stretches recovery to week 14+, index 92.
Hypothesis catastrophically falsified — concurrent regression caps recovery at 88.
claims.confidence_rationale: Second-order concurrent-risk scenario; honest tail probability.

output.reflection_question: What does this NOT cover that you wish it did?
output.user_response: Whether scenario B and C are correlated — if coordination drag predicts concurrent regression.
output.interpretation: User surfaces a hidden-correlation question between B and C.

output.reflection_question: What's the early signal that the hypothesis is wrong?
output.user_response: Weekly index in week 6 below 90 means scenario B or C is realising.
output.interpretation: User defines a clean week-6 falsification test.

output.reflection_question: Whose perspective haven't we tested the hypothesis against?
output.user_response: The customer's. We've stress-tested ops, not customer-side recovery friction.
output.interpretation: User opens a Get Perspectives followup path.

synthesis.body:
## Hypothesis under stress

The hypothesis — parallel recovery lands index ≥ 100 by week 12 — is **Possible** (45%). Two falsifying scenarios are credible (38% + 17%). The week-6 weekly-index reading is the load-bearing falsification test.

## Stop-at-hypothesis

Test Hypothesis stops here with a tested-but-not-decided verdict. Whether to commit depends on additional checks (week-6 falsification gate + Get Perspectives on the customer-side risk).

recommendations.heading: Watch week-6 weekly index as falsification gate
recommendations.body: Would treat weekly index < 90 by week 6 as falsification of the 12-week-to-100 hypothesis.
